description: Defines PDCP (Packet Data Convergence Protocol) configuration structures, enums, constants, and formatters for a 5G/4G radio system implementation, including parameters for sequence numbers, timers, security, and data handling.

classes.name: pdcp_metrics_notifier
classes.description: Forward declaration for a class responsible for PDCP metrics notification.

methods.name: pdcp_data_header_size
methods.description: Returns header size depending on sn_size.

methods.name: pdcp_data_trailer_size
